{{Quote|Eison Gynt was a fourth-generation Jedi, widely considered to be the most promising Padawan in the Order.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
'''Eison Gynt''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], born to a family line of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In his youth, he was considered the most talented [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and was taken as an apprentice by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Barel Ovair]], a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During a [[Mission to Yavin 4|mission]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to explore the [[Naga Sadow's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], Ovair abandoned Gynt. Ovair reported Gynt's [[Death/Legends|death]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but Gynt was still alive, possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Sadow. Under Sadow's control, Gynt resurfaced on Coruscant several years later and was slain by Ovair in [[Duel on Coruscant (Inter–Sith Wars Period)|open combat]]. Ovair's Imperial allegiance and complicity in Gynt's death were not revealed until years later, when [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]] researched the events of the mission to Yavin 4 and Gynt's reappearance.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Together Ovair and Gynt traveled the galaxy, studying the mysteries of the Force.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
[[File:DarkGynt.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Eison Gynt, possessed by Naga Sadow and garbed as a Massassi warrior, returns to Coruscant.]]
Eison Gynt was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic's]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who hailed from a family line of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] going back three generations. He was considered the most talented student in the Order when he was selected by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Barel Ovair]]&mdash;who was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]&mdash;as his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] apprentice. As fellow [[Jedi historian|Jedi scholars]],<ref name="Time7" /> Ovair and Gynt traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], studying [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and taking on increasingly daring tasks for the Order.<ref name="Time7" /> In [[3756 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the pair undertook a dangerous [[Mission to Yavin 4|mission]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to explore the [[Naga Sadow's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. This mission was carried out in the name of the Jedi Order, but Ovair was actually under orders from the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to eliminate any lingering traces of Sadow that might threaten the Empire during their [[Great Galactic War|impending invasion]] of the Galactic Republic. While on Yavin 4, Gynt and Ovair were attacked by [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors and forced into the depths of Sadow's tomb, where the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] dark energies still survived.<ref name="Time7" />

Ovair returned alone and injured to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] several weeks later, and when he made his report to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] he revealed that Gynt had been [[Death/Legends|killed]]. In truth, Gynt had survived and had been possessed by Sadow's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]]. Gynt resurfaced on Coruscant several years after the failed mission to Yavin 4, garbed as a Massassi warrior and intent on killing his former Master. Gynt [[Duel on Coruscant (Inter–Sith Wars Period)|attacked]] Ovair publicly, but Ovair defeated Gynt in the ensuing [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] and killed him. Ovair was hailed as a hero by the Republic for his actions.<ref name="Time7" />

Over a century later, Jedi historian [[Gnost-Dural]] researched the events surrounding Gynt's death. He questioned why the spirit of Sadow, having taken possession of Gynt, would have sought vengeance against Ovair specifically. Gnost-Dural concluded that Ovair and his Jedi ancestors were in fact spies working on behalf of the Sith [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], and that Ovair had manipulated Gynt into participating in the mission to Yavin 4 so that he could destroy Sadow's spirit. The Emperor had viewed the old Sith Lords as potential threats, and Sadow's defeat&mdash;despite Gynt's death&mdash;eliminated one of those threats, which made the invasion of the Republic easier during the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Time7" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Possessed by the dark spirit of Naga Sadow, Gynt attacked his former master in broad daylight. The brutal battle between the two was staged with all of the Republic watching. Gynt's borrowed powers were formidable, but Master Ovair won the day.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Time7" />}}
[[File:OvairVsGynt-TORT7.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A possessed Gynt attacks his former Master, Ovair.]]
Gynt was a talented [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]], and was believed to be the most gifted Padawan in the Jedi Order at his time of selection. However, his [[Force power/Legends|talents]] did not prevent him from being possessed by the spirit of Sith Lord Naga Sadow. When possessed by Sadow, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] abilities granted by the dark spirit were formidable, but were not sufficient to defeat Ovair. When Gynt resurfaced on Coruscant, the Nautolan was wearing the [[Sith apparel|robes]] of a Massassi warrior. Gynt wielded a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Time7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eison Gynt was introduced in ''[[Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?]]'', a video released on [[April 16]], [[2010]] as part of the [[Galactic Timeline]] series of lore videos published on the official site for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the timeline transcript, Gynt's name is misspelled once as "Eeson Gynt."<ref name="Time7" />
